# telnyx_porting_order_activation_job (Data Source)

An activation job of a porting order.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `activation_job_id` (String) The activation job.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies this activation job

### Read-Only

- `activate_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the activation job should be executed. This time should be between some activation window.
- `activation_type` (String) Specifies the type of this activation job
- `activation_windows` (Attributes List) List of allowed activation windows for this activation job (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--activation_windows))
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `status` (String) Specifies the status of this activation job
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.

<a id="nestedatt--activation_windows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `activation_windows`

Read-Only:

- `end_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the activation window ends
- `start_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the activation window starts
